annotations.title: Get the instructions for one setup step

description: What to do for one of Fictura's six setup steps, ready to follow: the instructions, this app's real values (so there is nothing to fill in), the full text of that step's docs pages, and how to check it worked. Call this when a person pastes a setup prompt, and follow what it returns rather than recalling the SDK from memory. Steps in order: install, connect, events, attribution, errors, performance.
name: get_setup_step
title: Get the instructions for one setup step
